math_and_control_flow.notation: C is positive capacity, H is observations seen (self.head), Q is a nonnegative requested count.
math_and_control_flow.current_iteration_count: min(H, Q), because the range is [max(0, H-Q), H).
math_and_control_flow.usable_clamped_count: U = min(Q, H, C); the logical interval is [H-U, H). An alternative rejection contract must define what happens when Q exceeds min(C, H).
math_and_control_flow.repeated_slot_condition: For positive C and nonnegative Q, repeated slots occur exactly when min(H, Q) > C. Q > C alone does not imply duplication before overwrite.
